responsibility: Defines RTL operand predicates used by LoongArch instruction patterns. It classifies immediates, symbolic addresses, call operands, move operands, small-data forms, comparison operators, and volatile/nonvolatile memory cases with LoongArch-specific legality tests such as code-model, explicit-reloc, and symbol-type checks, giving loongarch.md and sync.md precise operand matchers for recognition and expansion.
